```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data("penguins")
print(penguins)
```

1)  Understanding our data

```{r}
# Let's see the columns of our dataset with its datatypes
glimpse(penguins)

```

2)  Displaying only the columns names

```{r}
names(penguins)
```

3)  SInce there are many missing values let's drop them for the first case then revisit them for imputation

```{r}
library(gtExtras)
```

```{r}
cleaned_data = penguins %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  print()
```

```{r}
# Generating a summary for all the variables
cleaned_data %>% 
  summary()
```

Grouping Island by sex

```{r}
table(cleaned_data$island,cleaned_data$sex)
```

```{r}
cleaned_data %>% 
  select(flipper_length_mm,bill_length_mm) %>% 
  group_by(cleaned_data$sex) %>% 
  arrange(flipper_length_mm) %>% 
  print()
```

Let's create a new column called bill_length cm and add it to our cleaned data

```{r}
cleaned_data %>% 
  mutate(bill_length_cm = (bill_length_mm)/10) %>% 
  print() %>% 
  gt() %>% 
  gt_theme_guardian()
```

Displaying the median bill length mm and other Statistics

```{r}
median(cleaned_data$bill_length_mm)
mean(cleaned_data$body_mass_g)
mode(cleaned_data$sex)
cor(cleaned_data$bill_depth_mm,cleaned_data$bill_depth_mm)
var(cleaned_data$flipper_length_mm)
sd(cleaned_data$flipper_length_mm)
cov(cleaned_data$body_mass_g,cleaned_data$bill_depth_mm)
```

Plotting a histogram of the bill_length_mm variable

```{r}
boxplot(x= cleaned_data$bill_length_mm,title="Box Plot of the Bill length in MM",xlab = "bill_length_mm")
```

```{r}
# The lower whisker and upper whisker values for our boxplot
quantile(cleaned_data$bill_length_mm,0.25)
quantile(cleaned_data$bill_length_mm,0.75)

```

Displaying a scatterplot of bill_length vs bill_depth

```{r}
cleaned_data %>% 
ggplot(aes(x=bill_length_mm,y=bill_depth_mm))+
  geom_point(color = "green",alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title= "Scatterplot of Bill Length vs Bill Depth",xlab = "Bill Length",ylab = "Bill Depth")+
  facet_wrap(~sex)
```

```{r}
gt_plt_summary(cleaned_data$bill_length_mm,cleaned_data$body_mass_g)
```
